page.notes: The running head in the top centre is set in spaced capitals with mixed type and cannot be read reliably. Some letters in the body are doubtful: the ligatures in "fuisse" and "confuetudinis" are rendered as printed. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout, and the "s" ligature (ss) in "fuiffe" is read as ss. The page ends mid-word with "ful-" and has no catchword. The small marks at the foot of the page are printer's decoration and are not transcribed.
